title: Requests
query: index=container_logs sourcetype="eventpulse:application" | spath | foreach status duration_ms level msg method path request_id [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | where isnotnull(status) AND isnotnull(duration_ms) | stats count AS Requests

title: Server errors
query: index=container_logs sourcetype="eventpulse:application" | spath | foreach status duration_ms level msg method path request_id [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | where isnotnull(status) AND isnotnull(duration_ms) | stats count(eval(status>=500)) AS Errors

title: Error rate (4xx + 5xx)
query: index=container_logs sourcetype="eventpulse:application" | spath | foreach status duration_ms level msg method path request_id [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | where isnotnull(status) AND isnotnull(duration_ms) | stats count AS total count(eval(status>=400)) AS errors | eval Rate=if(total>0,round(100*errors/total,2),0) | fields Rate

title: P95 response time
query: index=container_logs sourcetype="eventpulse:application" | spath | foreach status duration_ms level msg method path request_id [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | where isnotnull(status) AND isnotnull(duration_ms) | stats perc95(duration_ms) AS P95 | eval P95=round(P95,2)

title: Requests over time
query: index=container_logs sourcetype="eventpulse:application" | spath | foreach status duration_ms level msg method path request_id [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | where isnotnull(status) AND isnotnull(duration_ms) | timechart span=1m count AS Requests

title: Average and P95 response time (ms)
query: index=container_logs sourcetype="eventpulse:application" | spath | foreach status duration_ms level msg method path request_id [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | where isnotnull(status) AND isnotnull(duration_ms) | timechart span=1m avg(duration_ms) AS Average perc95(duration_ms) AS P95

title: HTTP status distribution
query: index=container_logs sourcetype="eventpulse:application" | spath | foreach status duration_ms level msg method path request_id [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | where isnotnull(status) AND isnotnull(duration_ms) | stats count AS Requests by status

title: Errors by route
query: index=container_logs sourcetype="eventpulse:application" | spath | foreach status duration_ms level msg method path request_id [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | where isnotnull(status) AND isnotnull(duration_ms) | where status>=400 | stats count AS Errors by method path status | sort - Errors

title: Process CPU (%)
query: index=container_metrics sourcetype="eventpulse:application_metrics" | spath | foreach cpu_percent memory_rss_mb heap_used_mb uptime_seconds process_status [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | timechart span=30s avg(cpu_percent) AS CPU

title: Process memory (MB)
query: index=container_metrics sourcetype="eventpulse:application_metrics" | spath | foreach cpu_percent memory_rss_mb heap_used_mb uptime_seconds process_status [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | timechart span=30s avg(memory_rss_mb) AS RSS avg(heap_used_mb) AS Heap

title: Telemetry freshness (seconds)
query: index=container_metrics sourcetype="eventpulse:application_metrics" | spath | foreach cpu_percent memory_rss_mb heap_used_mb uptime_seconds process_status [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | stats latest(_time) AS last_seen | eval Age=round(now()-last_seen,0) | fields Age

title: Process uptime
query: index=container_metrics sourcetype="eventpulse:application_metrics" | spath | foreach cpu_percent memory_rss_mb heap_used_mb uptime_seconds process_status [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | stats latest(uptime_seconds) AS Uptime | eval Uptime=round(Uptime,0)

title: Process status
query: index=container_metrics sourcetype="eventpulse:application_metrics" | spath | foreach cpu_percent memory_rss_mb heap_used_mb uptime_seconds process_status [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | stats latest(process_status) AS Status

title: Busiest routes
query: index=container_logs sourcetype="eventpulse:application" | spath | foreach status duration_ms level msg method path request_id [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | where isnotnull(status) AND isnotnull(duration_ms) | stats count AS Requests avg(duration_ms) AS Average_ms perc95(duration_ms) AS P95_ms by method path | eval Average_ms=round(Average_ms,2),P95_ms=round(P95_ms,2) | sort - Requests

title: Slow requests (>1 second)
query: index=container_logs sourcetype="eventpulse:application" | spath | foreach status duration_ms level msg method path request_id [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | where isnotnull(status) AND isnotnull(duration_ms) | where duration_ms>1000 | sort - _time | table _time method path status duration_ms request_id

title: Recent application logs
query: index=container_logs sourcetype="eventpulse:application" | spath | foreach status duration_ms level msg method path request_id [ eval <<FIELD>>=mvindex(<<FIELD>>,0) ] | sort - _time | table _time level msg method path status duration_ms request_id
